summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DateFirst dating app MVP. Backend API testing achieved 93.8% success rate (15/16 tests passed). Frontend testing confirmed homepage loads with 20 seeded date posts, authentication flow works, and all major pages are accessible. One backend ObjectId serialization issue prevents date post creation.

critical_bugs.issue: ObjectId serialization error when creating date posts
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot create new date posts
critical_bugs.error_details: ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), TypeError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute')]

minor_issues.issue: Authorization error when accessing applications for posts not owned by user
minor_issues.impact: Expected behavior, but error message could be clearer

ui_bugs.issue: User session appears to expire quickly during navigation
ui_bugs.impact: Users get logged out when navigating between pages

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete date creation due to backend ObjectId error

passed_tests: Homepage loads with 20 seeded date posts
Navigation to all major pages (My Dates, Applications, Chat, Profile, Premium)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical ObjectId serialization issue in date post creation endpoint (/api/dates POST). The error occurs in FastAPI's jsonable_encoder when trying to serialize MongoDB ObjectId. Recommend using UUIDs consistently instead of ObjectIds, or implement proper ObjectId serialization. Also investigate session persistence issue causing users to get logged out during navigation.
